lines.text: Some sites will not let you copy.
You drag across the text, and nothing happens.
One click, and the page behaves normally again.
Select text. Right click. Control C.
For a site you use often, switch on Always unlock.
From then on, it runs before the site's own code.
That is the only thing that beats a page determined to stop you.
Copy buttons and text editors keep doing what they were doing.
And a fresh install cannot read a single website.
It asks for one site at a time, only when you ask it to.
Free, open source, and nothing is tracked.
